questions.question:
Select the option that corrects the misspelt words in the given sentence.

Evryone was talking and laufhing during the trip.

options.text: Everyone was talking and lauhging during the trip.
Everyone was talking and laughing during the trip.
Everyone was talking and laffing during the trip.
Evryone was talking and laughing during the trip.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **"Everyone was talking and laughing during the trip".** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

 
• In the given question, the spelling error is in both the words **"evyone"** and **"laufhing". **So, it is **wrong**. The correct spelling is **"everyone"** and **"laughing".**
 
• In **option **1, the spelling of **"laughing"** is **wrong**. We have to use the correct spelling "laughing" in place of the wrong spelling **"lauhging"** given in the option.
 
• In option 3, the spelling of "laughing" is **wrong**. We have to use the correct spelling "laughing" in place of the wrong spelling "**laffing**" given in the option.
 
• In option 4, the spelling of "**Everyone**" is **wrong**. We have to use the correct spelling "**Everyone**" in place of the wrong spelling "**Evryone**" given in the option.
 
• In option 2, the spelling of "laughing" and "everyone" is **right**. Hence, this is our answer as all spellings are correct in it.

Hence, the correct answer is "option 2".
